甲.name: The Oak
甲.l2: You are the Wood that rises before the path is clear.
A: You start before you are ready.
You start before you are ready, and others follow.
B: You move before the path is there.
You move before the path is there, and it forms behind you.
甲.card: People lean on the structure you build without noticing it is yours.
甲.ins: You grow toward a light you can't prove yet, and never stop to rest under it.

乙.name: The Vine
乙.l2: You are the Wood that gets there anyway.
A: You find the way around.
You find the way around, and people call it luck.
B: You get there the long way.
You get there the long way, and the climb goes unseen.
乙.card: You bend where others break, and arrive intact.
乙.ins: You find a way around what stops other people, and they call it luck.

丙.name: The Sun
丙.l2: You are the Fire that gives light before anyone asks.
A: You warm people before they ask.
You warm people before they ask, and rarely warm yourself.
B: People brighten when you arrive.
People brighten when you arrive, and feel it when you go.
丙.card: A room reads its mood from you before you say a word.
丙.ins: You warm whoever stands near you, and run on warmth nobody returns.

丁.name: The Candle
丁.l2: You are the Fire that burns closest, not widest.
A: You give one thing all of you.
You give one thing all of you, and the rest goes dark.
B: You light one person fully.
You light one person fully, and they remember it for years.
丁.card: You would rather light one person truly than a crowd dimly.
丁.ins: What you turn toward gets all of you, and everything else waits in the dark.

戊.name: The Mountain
戊.l2: You are the Earth others use to find their footing.
A: People lean on you without asking.
People lean on you without asking, and you let them.
B: You hold what others set down.
You hold what others set down, and few think to hold you.
戊.card: When plans wobble, yours is the version everyone quietly adopts.
戊.ins: You hold what others set down, and nothing has ever offered to hold you.

己.name: The Field
己.l2: You are the Earth that turns what it holds into growth.
A: What you tend grows.
What you tend grows, and others carry the harvest home.
B: People feel steadier near you.
People feel steadier near you and cannot say why.
己.card: People feel steadier after time with you and cannot say why.
己.ins: Everything you tend grows, and the harvest goes home in other people's hands.

庚.name: The Blade
庚.l2: You are the Metal that cuts things clean.
A: You say what others soften.
You say what others soften, and pay for it alone.
B: You say the thing out loud.
You say the thing out loud, then stand alone with it.
庚.card: People come to you when they need the unsoftened truth.
庚.ins: You say what others soften, then quietly pay for being the one who did.

辛.name: The Jewel
辛.l2: You are the Metal that refines until nothing extra remains.
A: You notice the flaw first.
You notice the flaw first, and your own before anyone's.
B: You polish what others would ship.
You polish what others would ship, and call it a draft.
辛.card: You notice the flaw everyone else has agreed to overlook.
辛.ins: You hold your work to a standard nobody set, and it never says finished.

壬.name: The Ocean
壬.l2: You are the Water that keeps moving without losing its depth.
A: You see the whole current.
You see the whole current, and keep most of it to yourself.
B: You carry more than you show.
You carry more than you show, and it reads as distance.
壬.card: You see the whole current while others watch the wave.
壬.ins: You understand more than you can explain, and live with the distance that leaves.

癸.name: The Rain
癸.l2: You are the Water that quietly changes whatever it touches.
A: You feel it before they say it.
You feel it before they say it, then carry it home.
B: You soak in what others feel.
You soak in what others feel, then wonder which is yours.
癸.card: You reach people through the small, quiet door, not the loud one.
癸.ins: You soak up what everyone around you feels, then wonder which of it is yours.
